provenance.primary_source: NAFEMS, 'The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks', TNSB Rev. 3 (1990), test LE1. Publication is paywalled; the engineer may supply the PDF into Reference/NAFEMS/ when obtained.
secondary_sources: Abaqus Benchmarks Manual, 'Elliptic membrane under uniform outward pressure' (NAFEMS LE1)
Altair OptiStruct Verification Manual, OS-V: NAFEMS LE1 elliptic membrane
provenance.note: Geometry, material, loading, and the 92.7 MPa target value agree across all listed secondary sources; recorded 2026-07-05 for src/fea Phase 2 Step 2 (plane-stress Quad4).

units.consistent_note: E and the edge load are entered in MPa with lengths in m; all recovered stresses are then in MPa directly (thickness cancels in plane stress).

geometry.description: Quarter model (symmetric) of an elliptic membrane: region between the inner ellipse (x/2.0)^2 + (y/1.0)^2 = 1 and the outer ellipse (x/3.25)^2 + (y/2.75)^2 = 1, first quadrant.

boundary_conditions.edge_y0: uy = 0 on the y = 0 symmetry edge (from (2.0, 0) to (3.25, 0))
boundary_conditions.edge_x0: ux = 0 on the x = 0 symmetry edge (from (0, 1.0) to (0, 2.75))

loading: Uniform OUTWARD normal traction (tension) of 10 MPa on the outer elliptic edge; inner edge free.

target.quantity: sigma_yy at point D (2.0, 0.0), the inner-ellipse point on the x axis
